topics.title: 课程作业
topics.summary: 在 PSL 直接运营的项目中，只有在教师授权时才可使用 AI 工具，且使用后必须披露。成员机构（高师、巴黎九大、巴黎矿业等）适用各自规则；例如高师 CIENS 中心只允许把 AI 作为临时辅助（翻译、文献探索、安排工作），并禁止用 AI 撰写正文。
topics.scope: 2026–27 学业规则下的教师授权；成员机构规则。

claims.text: Université PSL's Règlement de la scolarité for 2026-2027 (adopted by the Board on 25 June 2026, replacing the June 2025 version with the same AI wording) states that, where an instructor authorises AI-based tools such as ChatGPT, their use must be explicitly disclosed like any source citation, and failure to disclose AI use is treated as plagiarism and sanctioned as such; a disciplinary procedure may follow, with sanctions up to exclusion (not automatic exclusion). The 2026 version applies to programmes operated directly by PSL (such as the Collège Sciences, Humanités et Société and the Paris School of AI); member institutions apply their own regulations, so it does not set course permissions across ENS, Dauphine, Mines Paris and other members.

claims.text: The AI charter of CIENS (an interdisciplinary centre of ENS-PSL) applies to CIENS students, teachers and researchers only. It allows generative AI as occasional help for translation, document exploration, exploratory document analysis or organising work, but prohibits producing false references, developing a research problem and scientific reasoning, writing the text content, and giving AI sensitive, protected or confidential information. Any AI use must be stated in a note or the body of the text, naming the tool and the nature of use; undeclared use may be treated as academic fraud and lead to disciplinary sanctions. These are unit-level rules, not PSL-wide rules.

claims.text: PSL's Charte du doctorat (June 2026, section 2.7) sets general recommendations on generative AI for doctoral candidates, some of which are mandatory. Generative AI is not prohibited in doctoral research, but its uses must be transparent, declared and critically assessed, and the candidate remains fully responsible for AI-obtained content. Member institutions may set stricter rules, which prevail.

It allows generative AI as occasional help for translation, document exploration, exploratory document analysis or organising work, but prohibits producing false references, developing a research problem and scientific reasoning, writing the text content, and giving AI sensitive, protected or confidential information. Any AI use must be stated in a note or the body of the text, naming the tool and the nature of use; undeclared use may be treated as academic fraud and lead to disciplinary sanctions. These are unit-level rules, not PSL-wide rules.

evidence.quote: Cette charte vise à encadrer l’utilisation des IAg de manière éthique, responsable et durable pour les étudiants du CIENS mais aussi ses enseignants et ses chercheurs.
evidence.title: Charte d'utilisation de l'IA (CIENS, ENS-PSL)
evidence.location: Introduction; lines 109-109 of captured page text

evidence.quote: Ces outils peuvent constituer une aide ponctuelle dans certaines étapes du travail telles que la traduction, l’exploration documentaire, l’analyse exploratoire de documents ou encore l’organisation du travail. Cependant, ils ne se substituent en aucun cas à l’effort intellectuel et à la réflexion personnelle qui doivent être fournis.
evidence.title: Charte d'utilisation de l'IA (CIENS, ENS-PSL)
